conclusion: Native RPP path transformation and collision checks retained; command-space angular ramp overcomes input deadband and zero angular twist without raising the .8 acceleration setting. One-Hz same-goal replans preserve the ramp. Dynamic caps are enforced and invalid updates rejected. Frozen actual pose still aborts rather than falsely reporting arrival.
limitations: These are open-map direct FollowPath fixtures, not corner coverage or physical-hardware validation. No adaptive lookahead fallback is implemented.
